subject.title: [Feature]: Add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw add a core per-agent cost-observability contract for daily notification thresholds now, and if so should it be designed as the shared accounting foundation for the open budget-enforcement work?
rationale: The request adds a user-facing configuration surface and durable accounting behavior whose relationship to enforcement, provider billing accuracy, and notification delivery cannot be resolved safely from code-level mechanics alone.

options.title: Define shared cost accounting first
options.body: Adopt an informational per-agent accounting primitive with explicit estimate status, then layer alerts and any future enforcement on that common contract.

options.title: Keep notifications separate
options.body: Approve a narrowly scoped notification-only feature that does not promise reuse by gateway budget enforcement.

options.title: Defer to external monitoring
options.body: Keep core pull-based usage reporting and direct operators to provider dashboards or external accounting until a broader cost-control direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Define shared cost accounting first
recommendation.body: Adopt an informational per-agent accounting primitive with explicit estimate status, then layer alerts and any future enforcement on that common contract.

likelyOwner.reason: A named owner cannot be established without repository history access; the decision belongs with the owners of agent runtime, config, and provider-cost behavior.
